name: Salimi Engineering
businessModel: Small founder-led engineering bureau. Focused technical assignments and medium-sized project scopes. Project teams are assembled around the scope: discipline engineers and specialists are engaged or hired for the assignment.
accountability: SALIMI Yunes, founder and lead engineer, holds technical responsibility and the client relationship.

services.name: Owner's Engineering & AMO
services.summary: Independent technical representation of the client: requirements, design review, tender and bid analysis, variation and substitution assessment, site inspection, commissioning and handover.

services.name: Electrical & MEP Engineering
services.summary: Load calculations, power distribution, lighting and small power, ventilation and HVAC interfaces, fire detection and low-current systems, MEP coordination, specifications and construction-issue drawings.

services.name: Local Engineering Partner in Morocco
services.summary: Site surveys, contractor coordination, scheduled local representation, construction monitoring and commissioning support for teams based outside Morocco.

experienceAttribution.statement: Unless a record states otherwise, listed projects reflect the founder's prior professional experience in previous engineering roles, not assignments delivered by Salimi Engineering.
